question: Related Questions Q. Dream 1424 views Q. خواب كی تعبیر بتائیں 1246 views Q. My questions are related to dreams and I ask for interpretation, inshaAllah. 1. I met her in the street at the time just before the sun raises /it wasn't neither dark, nor light/. The street was empty. My neighbour told me 'You will all burn in Hell even your young /innocent/ children'. In life she admires us and is tollerant but I am worried about what I saw in my dream. 3. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 9525 Country: NG Title: I had a dream that i saw new moon, what doese it mean? Question: I had a dream that i saw new moon, what doese it mean? Answer ID: 9525 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2500/407=TH/1429) It is a nice dream. It means that you shall feel freshness in iman and good deeds and will have its pleasure from Allah, in-sha-Allah. Keep on following sunnah in each matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
